content: Joacim Judá-yar-semaidgine, Babilonia-dulemar-rey-Nabucodonosor egi bila onononikid. A-bila-onosadgi, Nabucodonosor Joacimʼgi nakwisad. Geb agi, Judá-dulemar Nabucodonosor-sogedba birgapaa ibmar-imakdii gusad. Geb a-sorbali, Rey-Joacim, Nabucodonosor-sogedba bar ibmar-imakbisur gualid.
Agine, Bab-Jehová, Joacimʼgi, degi, Judá-dulemargi-gwisguegala, wemar-barmiar gusad:

content.text: Moab-sordamar, degi, Amón-sordamar egi barmiar gusad.
Igi Bab-Jehová, ega-gayaburba-barsogmaladba ibmar-guoye sogsagusa, deyob gusad.

content: Bab-Jehová-sogedba Judá-dulemar sabsur-odurdaklesad.

content.text: Degisoggu, Bab-Jehová Judá-dulemarga, igi-barsaye gwen sogsasulid.

content: Joacim e-ibmar-imaksad, degi, ibmar-imaksad-baigan, Judá-e-reymar-ibmar-imaksad-gardagi narmakar maid.
Rey-Joacim burgwisgu, e-machi-Joaquín e-sorba yar sesad.

Babilonia-e-rey bela Egipto-yar-gasasoggu, Egipto-dulemar-e-rey bar Egipto-yargi nossulid. Ar ade, Babilonia-e-rey Egipto-diwar-maid-akale, Éufrates-diwar-maidse, Egipto-e-rey-yarmar-ganikidi, bela gasad.
Joaquín, Judá-yar-sesad
Joaquín birgambe-gakabaabak-nikadgi (18) yar sealid. Jerusalénʼgi nii-warbaa yar sesad. E-nan Nehustaʼye nugad, Elnatán-e-sisgwad. Nehustaʼde, Jerusalénʼginedid.
Joaquín Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abemaisulidi, Bab-Jehová-asabin imaksad. Ar e-bab-ibmar-imaksadba ibmar imaksamogad.
A-ibagangi, Babilonia-e-rey-Nabucodonosor-e-sorda-bila-onomalad, Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis ambikunonigusad.
Degi, Babilonia-Rey-Nabucodonosor, e-sordamar-Jerusalén-neggwebur-ebilis-bukwadgi, Jerusalénʼse nonikid.

Geb Judá-rey-Joaquín, e-nanmala, degi, ega-arbamaladmala, e-dule-dummaganmala, degine, e-sorda-bila-onomalad-e-dummaganmala, Babilonia-e-reyse galakunonimalad. Geb galesmalad. Deunni, Nabucodonosor birgabaabakgus (8) Babilonia-yargi negsemaid.

Ar igi Bab-Jehová sogsagusa, deyob ibmar gusad. Nabucodonosor, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi ibmar-nuegan-bukwad bela sesad, degi, reyneggi ibmar-nuegan-bukwadse-bakale, bela sesad. Nabucodonosor, Bab-Jehováʼse-goled-neggi-ibmar-ebulemalad bela goamaksabalid. We-ibmar Rey-Salomón orbi-sobsagusadid.
Deginbali, Nabucodonosor, bela dule Jerusalénʼginmalad-gasa sesa gusad:

content.text: Belagwable miliambe (10,000) dulemar-gasa sesad. Unnila, dule-wileganabi napi obesad.

content: Degi, Rey-Nabucodonosor, wemar-gasa Babilonia-yarse sesa gusad:

content.text: Degine, Nabucodonosor, bela dulemar-bila-onolegedgi-urwemalad-gasa Babilonia-yarse sesa gusbalid.

content: Geb a-sorbali, Nabucodonosor, Joaquín-e-gilor Mataníasʼye nugad, Judá-e-reyga nug-imaksad. Geb ega nug ogwasad, Sedequíasʼye onugsasad.
Sedequías, Judá-yar-sesad
Sedequías birga-durgwen-gakagwensak-nikadgi (21) yar sealid. Jerusalénʼgi birgambe-gakagwensak (11) yar sesad. E-nandi, Hamutalʼye nugad, Jeremías-e-sisgwad. Hamutalʼde, Libnaʼginedid.
Sedequías Bab-Jehová-ibmar-abemaisulidi, Bab-Jehová-asabin imaksad. Ar ade, Sedequías, Joacim-ibmar-isgana-imaksadba ibmar imaksamogad.
Degidbali, Bab-Jehová Jerusalén-dulemargi, degi, Judá-dulemargi uluar gusad. Degisoggu, Bab-Dummad amar-obachasunnad. A-sorbali, Sedequías, Babilonia-e-reygi gwichigusad.
